prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:

The BBB listing shows an **A+ rating**; the company’s listed number is **(417) 781-6811**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/home-renovation) · [Company website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com)
